$comment: Knowledge-base sources (ADR-0005 iteration 6; ADR-0013 iterations 5–6, 21). File names and titles only; the content lives in the team's Drive folder and never in git. `dir`: 'kb' = the Drive knowledgebase folder (--kb-dir), 'local' = kb/local-sources/ (git-ignored). `sourceLabel` sets priority, highest first (Kay, 2026-11-16: 'faq -> ada -> book'): 'care_team' (the clinician FAQ), then 'ADA' (the two guides and the five handouts), then 'book'. Search ranks them in that order on an equal match; 'care_team' and 'ADA' numbers count, 'book' numbers never do, and book text is never shown word for word (QST-KB-BOOK-ROLE: A). `startAt` / `endAt` (optional): regexes on the extracted text; only the text from the first startAt match up to the first endAt match is used.
